subHeadline: The question every Mercedes-Benz owner eventually faces, answered honestly rather than sold around. We tell you when to repair, when to replace, and when to scrap - based on real UK data, not estimates.

ruleOfThumb.title: The Mercedes-Benz Rule of Thumb
ruleOfThumb.text: If reconditioned engine cost runs at 70% or more of what your car is actually worth on today's market, get a scrap valuation alongside any repair quote - don't decide on repair cost alone. This is our Mercedes-specific threshold, reflecting the higher parts and labour baseline premium German brands share.
